title: Matchbox: The Movie
plot_overview: When a group of former childhood friends reunites, their plans take an unexpected turn as they become caught up in a dangerous international plot. They must work together to stop the threat and save the world, in a globe-spanning adventure that mixes action with comedy and puts their old friendship to the test.
will_you_like_this: You’ll enjoy this if you’re after a silly, high-energy action comedy with old friends, big set pieces, and lighthearted fun; Not for you if you want a fresh, thoughtful thriller or a close connection to Matchbox cars.
review_summary: Pros: lively action; playful humor; cast chemistry | Cons: predictable story; thin toy connection; uneven pacing
